images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 blockbuster micro-story on a luminous Moon landing frontier with Earth on the horizon. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. As a fearless cosmic expedition commander in an original white exploration suit, the cat shows dramatic hiss with visible tiny fangs and performs dramatic exhausted flop on padded lunar ground. A tiny conductor inside the suit pocket signals a miniature train departure; its open carriage releases a visible wave of cherry blossoms. Behind the train, a gigantic dinosaur shadow appears through safe forced perspective and a thin cinematic safety wire, clearly a staged silhouette. Camera distance five meters, ground-level diagonal viewpoint, 32mm lens, moderate depth of field keeping cat, pocket, blossoms, and shadow readable, sharp solar rim light, blue Earth bounce, fine dust particles and realistic fabric contact. Harmless theatrical staging, no actual danger. Correct feline anatomy, no duplicate cats, no extra limbs, no human features, no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, or readable title.
